description: This PHP abstract class 'PurgeStrategy' defines a common interface and base logic for different data purging strategies in the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It manages entities related to employee data, providing methods for constructing purge parameters, retrieving data via associated services, and encapsulating common functionality for subclasses.

classes.name: PurgeStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class for implementing various data purging strategies, providing utility methods for interacting with the purge service and managing entity-related data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purge strategy with the specified entity class name and info array containing match and parameter data.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: An abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to perform the purging operation for a given employee number.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the associated PurgeService object.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Constructs and returns an array of match criteria to identify entities related to a specific employee number.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves entity data records from the database based on match criteria and table name using the purge DAO.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters array related to the purge strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the entity this strategy operates on.

methods.name: getEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the mapping of entity fields used in match criteria.
